title: DyHist: Query-Aware Historical Dynamics Modeling for Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation aims to predict future facts from observed historical events. Existing methods usually achieve this goal by jointly modeling local historical evolution and long-range historical contexts. First, local evolution modeling often summarizes local history into an overall evolving representation, where query-relevant local deviations may not be sufficiently exploited as useful predictive features. Second, existing long-range history modeling often treats historical recurrence as a stable cue, while overlooking that its reliability may vary across relations and recent contexts. To address these issues, we propose DyHist, a query-aware historical dynamics modeling framework for TKG extrapolation. DyHist captures local dynamics by separating recent evidence from medium-range contexts and explicitly modeling their query-relevant deviations as predictive features. translated_title: DyHist：面向时序知识图谱外推的查询感知历史动态建模
translated_abstract: 时序知识图谱（TKG）外推旨在从已观测的历史事件中预测未来事实。现有方法通常通过联合建模局部历史演化与长程历史上下文来实现这一目标。首先，局部演化建模往往将局部历史总结为一个整体演化表示，其中与查询相关的局部偏差可能未被充分挖掘为有用的预测特征。其次，现有的长程历史建模通常将历史循环视为稳定线索，而忽视了其可靠性可能因关系和近期上下文的不同而变化。为解决这些问题，我们提出了DyHist，一个面向时序知识图谱外推的查询感知历史动态建模框架。DyHist通过将近期证据与中程上下文分离，并显式地将二者的查询相关偏差建模为预测特征来捕捉局部动态。它进一步采用一种关系感知的历史……
tldr: 提出DyHist框架，通过查询感知地建模历史动态——分离近期证据与中程上下文的查询相关偏差，并关系感知地评估历史循环的可靠性——从而提升时序知识图谱外推的预测效果。
en_tdlr: DyHist is a query-aware historical dynamics modeling framework that enhances temporal knowledge graph extrapolation by explicitly modeling query-relevant deviations between recent evidence and medium-range contexts, and by relation-aware assessment of historical recurrence reliability.
